name: forwarding-discord-telegram
description: Selfbot that forwards your Discord messages to Telegram

scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.pkg.json && find dist-cjs -name '*.js' -exec sh -c 'mv "$1" "${1%.js}.cjs"' _ {} \; && find dist-cjs -name '*.cjs' -exec sed -i.bak "s/\\.js\"/\\.cjs\"/g" {} \; && find dist-cjs -name '*.bak' -delete
scripts.build:cjs:pkg: pnpm run build:cjs && find dist-cjs -name '*.cjs' -exec sh -c 'cp "$1" "${1%.cjs}.js" && sed -i.bak "s/\\.cjs\"/\\.js\"/g" "${1%.cjs}.js" && rm "${1%.cjs}.js.bak"' _ {} \;
scripts.pkg: pnpm run build:cjs && pkg package.pkg.json --public --public-packages "*" --no-bytecode --no-native-build --output bin/forwarding-discord-telegram
scripts.pkg:linux: pnpm run build:cjs:pkg && pkg dist-cjs/index.js --targets node18-linux-x64 --public --public-packages "*" --no-bytecode --no-native-build --config package.pkg.json --output bin/forwarding-discord-telegram-linux
scripts.pkg:macos: pnpm run build:cjs:pkg && pkg dist-cjs/index.js --targets node18-macos-x64 --public --public-packages "*" --no-bytecode --no-native-build --config package.pkg.json --output bin/forwarding-discord-telegram-macos
scripts.pkg:win: pnpm run build:cjs:pkg && pkg dist-cjs/index.js --targets node18-win-x64 --public --public-packages "*" --no-bytecode --no-native-build --config package.pkg.json --output bin/forwarding-discord-telegram-win.exe
scripts.pkg:all: pnpm run build:cjs && pkg package.pkg.json --targets node18-linux-x64,node18-macos-x64,node18-win-x64 --public --public-packages "*" --no-bytecode --no-native-build --output bin/forwarding-discord-telegram
